WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        dateDiff('month', MAX(DateKey), toDate('2009-12-31')) AS months_since_last,
        sum(SalesAmount)                                       AS total_spend,
        countDistinct(ProductKey)                              AS distinct_products
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_spend,
        distinct_products,
        CASE
            WHEN months_since_last <= 6  THEN 'Active'
            WHEN months_since_last <= 12 THEN 'At Risk'
            ELSE                              'Churned'
        END AS recency_segment
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT
    recency_segment,
    count()                       AS customer_count,
    avg(total_spend)              AS avg_spend_per_customer,
    avg(distinct_products)        AS avg_distinct_products_per_customer
FROM customer_segments
GROUP BY recency_segment
ORDER BY
    CASE recency_segment
        WHEN 'Active'   THEN 1
        WHEN 'At Risk'  THEN 2
        WHEN 'Churned'  THEN 3
    END
